endpoints.name: Kwai Profile API
endpoints.description: Retrieve one public Kwai profile by username or supported profile URL with normalized identity, profile imagery, account flags, visible counts, and collection context.

url.description: A non-empty profile reference whose parsed hostname is kwai.com, kwai-video.com, or a subdomain of either host. Any scheme is accepted when an authority and hostname are present; protocol-relative references are also accepted.

username.description: A Kwai username with one optional leading @ followed by 1 to 64 ASCII letters, digits, periods, underscores, or hyphens, for a maximum total length of 65 characters.

endpoints.name: Kwai User Posts API
endpoints.description: Collect one page of public Kwai posts from a username or supported profile URL, returning text, author, media, hashtags, timestamps, and visible engagement as normalized records.

url.description: A non-empty profile reference whose parsed hostname is kwai.com, kwai-video.com, or a subdomain of either host. Any scheme is accepted when an authority and hostname are present; protocol-relative references are also accepted.

username.description: A Kwai username with one optional leading @ followed by 1 to 64 ASCII letters, digits, periods, underscores, or hyphens, for a maximum total length of 65 characters.

endpoints.name: Kwai Post API
endpoints.description: Retrieve one public Kwai post from a known kwai.com or kwai-video.com URL, returning normalized text, author, media, timestamps, and visible engagement.

url.description: A non-empty post reference whose parsed hostname is kwai.com, kwai-video.com, or a subdomain of either host. Any scheme is accepted when an authority and hostname are present; protocol-relative references are also accepted.
